kai: Putting up a short RN draft for tonight's quick patch (runtime v2.3.8). Window 23:45 PT -> 00:30 PT. Fixes: batching stall under sporadic spikes, Dedicated scaler cooldown, small KV cache init guard. Need sign-off on copy + rollback plan.

sam-ops: I can run this. Proposed canary: 4% -> 30% -> 100%, 10m holds. Rollback triggers: sustained error-rate >=2% for 5m OR p95 > 850ms for 10m OR new PagerDuty alerts.

maria: RN nit: replace "KV cache init guard" with "KV cache NPE protection" and add Known Impact: "Short reconnects for Dedicated customers during pod churn." I'll update the doc.

jon: Infra: prefer 40m pin to previous version (v2.3.7) after full rollout so we have time to triage. Adding runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/runtime-deploy.

sam-ops: Deploy command when staging is green:
```
/deploy service=runtime version=v2.3.8 canary=4% step=10m health=svc-metrics-check
```
To abort: `deploybot cancel 1765565432`. Rollback manual cmd:
```
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version v2.3.7 --reason "canary failure"
routing pin runtime v2.3.7 --duration 40m
```

deploybot: deploy queued by sam-ops. Staging smoke pending. Will post progress here.

kai: I'll publish the internal brief at 23:20 PT. Final ask: confirm rollback thresholds and 40m pin.

maria: Confirmed. RN updated.

jon: Confirmed. Infra ready.

sam-ops: Confirmed. Starting at 23:45 unless hold. :rocket:
